name: gha-indie-worker-infra

ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN.description: Optional fine-grained GitHub token with read-only Contents access to private ORESoftware/ores-cli for oresc edge-management commands. The compose stack itself does not require this token.

TUNNEL_TOKEN.description: Optional Cloudflare named-tunnel connector token consumed by oresc codespace edge up.

postCreateCommand: bash -euc 'if ! command -v ores-compose >/dev/null 2>&1; then CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/ORESoftware/ores-compose.git --rev 9fbbaf4580b91c1445ec91f67ad3b31252094171 --bin ores-compose; fi; if ! command -v oresc >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -n "${ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN:-}"; then GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" gh auth setup-git >/dev/null; GH_TOKEN="$ORES_CLI_READ_TOKEN" CARGO_NET_GIT_FETCH_WITH_CLI=true cargo install --locked --git https://github.com/ORESoftware/ores-cli.git --rev c854130ee147e9793a3af8736e90241630a5c934 --bin oresc; fi; cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/dev-runtime/Cargo.toml -- bootstrap; cargo run --locked --manifest-path tools/dev-runtime/Cargo.toml -- check; if command -v oresc >/dev/null 2>&1; then just codespace-edge-check; else echo "oresc not installed; compose launch is ready, Cloudflare edge-management commands are optional"; fi'

8080.label: GHA Indie Worker Rust edge load balancer
